name: BYW: Orlando 00

date.source: No explicit air date is stated anywhere in the held record; the card was announced 22 April 2005 against a roleplay deadline extended twice, to 6 and then 8 May 2005, before the show was called off outright that November. This date reflects the last stated deadline, not a confirmed taping or air date.

evidence.source: This wing's own card announcement, posted 22 April 2005 to its Backyard Action sub-forum
evidence.note: States the full five-match lineup and stipulations, presented as "Steve Savoy and the WFW" bringing wrestlers from several other federations together for one unsanctioned Orlando show.

evidence.source: This wing's own five match-promo threads (24 April-9 May 2005)
evidence.note: Carry promos toward four of the five announced matches (no promo survives for the six-man tag's Craig Miles/Not Craig Miles/Mike Randalls side, nor for two of the Softcore Invitational's six announced entrants); none carries a result.

evidence.source: This wing's own operator, posting for the record on 11 November 2005
evidence.note: States plainly that "the BYW was cancelled as there were like 3 RPs for the entire card"; no result document was ever written for any of the five announced matches.

notes: Billed as five matches: a Softcore Invitational elimination match for the Chris Horowitz Memorial Softcore Championship Trophy (Superstar Ruger, Larry Tact, Robbie Wright, Beau Michaels-Cruise, Diablo and an unnamed "Mystery Opponent"); JA vs. Anarky; a six-man tag (the Crack Rock Crowd vs. Craig Miles, Not Craig Miles and Mike Randalls); a reverse bra-and-panties match (Psycho Granny vs. MWG); and a tag match billed as the reunion of the Vampire Hunters (Michael Manson and Alex Wylde vs. Jonathan Marx and Pitt). No result, of any kind, for any of the five survives; the fed's own operator confirmed the show's cancellation that November, citing too few posted roleplays to complete the card.
